meaning: The guard against definitional smuggling, from no premises: defining potency (Metaphysics IX.6) or being moved (Physics III.1) in the way the case's definition records describe them would make STMT-NOTHING-IN-ACT-AND-POTENCY-IN-SAME-RESPECT or STMT-NOTHING-MOVED-EXCEPT-AS-IN-POTENCY analytic, but would discharge nothing: each analysis is satisfiable exactly when its premise holds, so the open question would only move to the analysis's fidelity.
